clock_hz.source: the shell clock (docs/f2.md); to verify in M3 (one lane) and M9 (the whole design)

memory_clock_hz.source: HBM ports on the shell clock

macs_per_lane.source: docs/architecture.md, engine: 128 x 4 x 2 B = 1024 B/cycle, all 32 HBM ports at 250 MHz

accumulators.source: docs/architecture.md, engine: 4 multiply-adds x a 4-cycle loop (D-027)

command_cycles.source: none yet (the controller is designed in M2/M7)

engine_startup_cycles.source: per engine command that waits for an earlier result (D-042), weights or KV read ahead: the most a SmolLM2 engine command after the first took over its engine cycles (SCORES at positions 1023 and 8191; MATVECs 61), 128-lane RTL in simulation (reports/data/M5-engine.json, real); scenarios with other lanes or accumulators reuse it (estimate: its drain and final sum change with them)

softmax_fused.source: D-054: softmax's subtraction, exp and sum in one vector pass, with an FP32 adder before and after each slot's chain; 1 once built (M6)

max_in_drain.source: D-054: the engine keeps each score row's max as it writes it, so softmax has no MAX pass; 1 once built (with D-051's engine work)

kv_tiles_shared.source: Q-27: a K or V tile serves every query head of its group; not planned
